THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WANDIMOD-WANDI_MOD.0-: This spire... is the tallest tombstone I have ever seen. Architect, your creations have fallen.
Deathless one... you arrive with a soul riddled with scars. Blood and vengeance led you here, yet victory is not what you seek.
What I seek is an end. And you happen to stand between me and death.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WANDIMOD-WANDI_MOD.1-: Again? Good. My spear has never been so thirsty.
You return again and again, chasing a death forever out of reach. Perhaps you yourself are the eternal curse.
